title: Case IX (Serial 0066.00): side and end view illustrations of object, Aug 13, 1947
description: Two shaded illustrations of a flat-topped, trapezoidal object with a wide flanged base, labeled "Side view" and "End view"; the end view shows round pods on either side. Above them, typed text describes a farmer and his two sons seeing an object about 20 feet in diameter and 10 feet thick, with flames shooting from side pods, near a canyon wall on August 13, 1947. Page numbered 85.
